headline: A 2015 law renames a federal building and courthouse in Charleston, South Carolina, after Judge J. Waties Waring.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the federal building and U.S. courthouse at 83 Meeting Street in Charleston, South Carolina. The new name is the "J. Waties Waring Judicial Center." The law does not change how the courthouse operates or who uses it.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on August 7, 2015.
